_설명: 『運転手のくせに』 PHASE 4 키프레임 pilot2: 1컷 x 후보 2장 = 2장, 약 0.08달러. 생성: scripts/build_untenshu_keyframes.py (스토리보드 keyframe_prompt + 시트 칸 참조).

characters.prompt: Create ONE single photorealistic cinematic film still — one frame only, NOT a grid. Reference images: the people's faces, hair and clothes must match their reference images exactly (same person); the last reference is the location — keep its space and lighting. Photorealistic live-action Japanese TV drama, Arri Alexa cinematic color grade, Kodak 35mm film grain, 24fps, 16:9, restrained Japanese film mise-en-scene, natural lived-in detail, no flat lighting. Camera on the dashboard at the passenger side looking back into the rear seat: Otsuka in the back seat leaning forward into the gap between the two front seats, one hand gripping the top of the front passenger seat, glaring toward the driver, red brake light on his face; at the left edge of the frame the driver is seen in side profile, eyes on the road ahead through the windshield, NOT looking at Otsuka. Characters: Otsuka Koji, a thickset Japanese man aged 45, a broad ruddy face, thick heavy black eyebrows, black hair stiffly gelled with a hard side parting, clean-shaven, no glasses, a gold wristwatch on his LEFT wrist, wearing a grey pinstripe business suit with the loud red paisley necktie loosened, jacket rumpled and damp from the rain | Kuroda Soichiro the taxi driver, a lean Japanese man aged 67, a long calm dignified face, thick white hair swept back under the cap, a short neatly trimmed white moustache, one small dark mole on his RIGHT cheek, no glasses, wearing a plain navy peaked driver's cap with no badge, plain white cotton gloves, a white shirt with a plain navy V-neck vest, seen in side profile at the frame edge facing forward toward the windshield. People look like real Japanese drama actors photographed on set: real skin texture with visible pores and fine lines, subtle asymmetry, natural matte skin, restrained believable expressions, bare unadorned earlobes and no jewellery. Camera: low-angle looking up, 85mm prime lens, f/1.8, shallow depth of field, razor-sharp focus on the irises, soft optical bokeh. Lighting: inside a taxi at night: harsh red brake-light reflection from the car ahead flooding the cabin, teal shadows, tension. Car-interior geometry: the driver always faces forward toward the windshield; the passenger in the back seat speaks toward the driver from behind. The speaker's face at least one quarter of the frame height at a three-quarter angle, sharp focus on the speaker's eyes; the driver only a soft side profile at the frame edge. All papers, screens, signs, cards and labels are completely blank; no letters, numbers or symbols anywhere in the frame. Any car license plate is a plain green plate with a thin white border and no characters; any taxi roof lamp is a plain white dome with no characters. Negative: gibberish, foreign text, incomprehensible letters, fake alphabets, blurry typography, text on badge, text on name tag, logo on shirt, signage lettering, kanji on lanterns, posters with writing, documents with writing, screens with text, printed labels, brand logos, characters on license plates, watermarks, stamps, symbols on collar, bad anatomy, deformed eyes, extra fingers, extra arms, duplicate people, blood, gore, police. Car-interior conversation framing: the speaker's face fills at least one quarter of the frame height and is in razor-sharp focus; the driver is only a soft side profile at the frame edge, facing forward toward the windshield, never turned toward the back seat; the speaker's mouth is gently CLOSED in this frame (speech is added later), emotion shown in the eyes, brows and jaw. Natural five-fingered hands only where described. CAMERA: low angle, looking up. Every paper, document, card, screen, meter display, license plate and roof lamp surface is completely blank and clean: NO characters, NO numbers (Japanese text is composited later). Full-frame 16:9 image filling the whole canvas: NO black bars, NO white borders, NO letterbox or pillarbox.
